# Rupert

Rupert runs investor research, targeting, personalized outreach and follow-up for founders raising capital. Every reply and investor relationship stays yours.

## Articles

- [How to Find Investors for Your Startup: The Complete Guide](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/angel-investors/): Learn how to find angel investors, VCs, and micro-funds — with a qualified target list, warm intro tactics, and pipeline management for Seed founders.
- [Angel Investors vs. Venture Capital: What Fits Your Raise?](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/angel-investors-vs-venture-capital/): Angels and VCs differ on check size, stage fit, and governance. This guide helps founders decide which investor type fits their raise and when to target both.
- [The Biggest VC Firms in 2026: Ranked by AUM, Stage, Sector](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/biggest-venture-capital-firms/): A ranked overview of the world's biggest venture capital firms by AUM, stage, and sector — and what those rankings mean for early-stage founders.
- [Biggest Silicon Valley VC Firms: Active at Seed and Series A](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/biggest-venture-capital-firms-in-silicon-valley/): The biggest Silicon Valley VC firms ranked by Seed and Series A activity — with check sizes, sector focus, and a realistic fit assessment for founders.
- [Early-Stage Venture Capital: What It Is and How to Access It](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/early-stage-venture-capital/): Understand the early-stage VC landscape — who invests at pre-seed through Series A, what they look for, and how to target the right funds fast.
- [Famous VC Firms FAQ: What Every First-Time Founder Must Know](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/famous-venture-capital-firms/): The most famous VC firms earn reputations through landmark exits, not just AUM. Here's what first-time founders need to know before targeting them.
- [How to Get Investors for Your Business: A Founder's Guide](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/how-to-get-investors-for-your-business/): Everything founders need to know to attract, approach, and close the right investors — from building your target list to running a disciplined process.
- [Get Investors for Your Business Idea: Readiness Checklist](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/how-to-get-investors-for-your-business-idea/): Wondering how to get investors for your business idea? This pre-traction checklist covers everything founders need before their first pitch.
- [How to Get Private Investors for Your Business: A Guide](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/how-to-get-private-investors-for-your-business/): A step-by-step guide for founders approaching angels, family offices, and high-net-worth backers — from defining your raise to closing the loop.
- [Investor Database: How Founders Find, Filter, and Use One](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/investor-database/): A founder's guide to investor databases: what they cover, how to filter by stage and sector, and how to turn a qualified list into real meetings.
- [What Investors Looking for Projects to Fund Actually Want](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/investors-looking-for-projects-to-fund/): Discover what active investors evaluate before funding a project — team quality, market size, traction by stage, and deal terms that actually close.
- [How to Use Largest VC Firms by AUM to Build Your Target List](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/largest-venture-capital-firms-by-aum/): AUM rankings show VC firm size, not fit. Learn to filter by fund vintage, check size, and sector to build an investor list that actually matches your raise.
- [Pitch Deck: A Founder's Complete Guide to Raising Capital](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/pitch-deck/): What every pitch deck must include, how structure changes from seed to Series A, and what turns a strong deck into investor meetings and term sheets.
- [Pre-Seed vs Seed Pitch Deck: What Changes Between Rounds](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/pre-seed-pitch-deck/): A practical guide to how pre-seed and seed pitch decks differ in structure, evidence, and investor expectations — so the right deck reaches the right people.
- [Seed Pitch Deck FAQ: Practical Questions, Honest Answers](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/seed-funding-pitch-deck-faq/): Fast answers to the questions founders ask most when finalizing a seed pitch deck: format, length, when to send it, and what investors actually read.
- [The Complete Seed Pitch Deck Guide for Raising Founders](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/seed-pitch-deck/): Learn what goes in a seed pitch deck, which slides drive investor decisions, and how to build one that gets meetings in a competitive funding market.
- [Seed Pitch Deck Examples: 7 Real Decks — and What Worked](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/seed-pitch-deck-examples/): Seven real seed pitch decks that raised funding — what each one got right, why investors said yes, and the structural lessons you can apply to your own raise.
- [Seed Round Pitch Deck: Structure All 12 Slides Step-by-Step](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/seed-round-pitch-deck-template/): A slide-by-slide framework for your seed pitch deck — what each of the 12 slides must prove, in what order, and how to close with a clear, specific ask.
- [Series A Funding: The Complete Founder's Guide for 2026](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/series-a/): What Series A really means in 2026: round sizes, ARR benchmarks, valuation math, dilution, the fundraising process timeline, and how to find a lead investor.
- [Startup Funding: A Founder's Full Guide to Raising Capital](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/startup-funding/): What founders need to know about startup funding: stages, instruments, investor targeting, and how to run a disciplined raise from pre-seed to Series A.
- [Startup Funding Rounds: FAQ for Founders Who Are Raising](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/startup-funding-rounds-faq/): Founders' most-asked questions on startup funding rounds answered plainly: how much to raise, equity to give up, timeline, due diligence, and common mistakes.
- [Startup Funding Stages: The Definitive Guide for Founders](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/startup-funding-stages/): From pre-seed to Series C, understand what each startup funding stage demands, who invests, how much to raise, and which milestones unlock the next round.
- [How to Diagnose Your Startup Funding Stage and Raise Right](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/startup-funding-stages-explained/): A step-by-step process for founders to diagnose their funding stage, map traction to benchmarks, time their raise, and match with the right investors.
- [Top VC Firms: Mega-Fund or Specialist — Pitch Which First?](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/top-vc-firms/): Should you pitch a mega-fund or a sector specialist first? The answer depends on your signal, stage, and round competitiveness — here's the framework.
- [Startup Funding Types: Equity, SAFEs, Debt & Bootstrapping](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/types-of-funding-for-startups/): A side-by-side breakdown of equity rounds, SAFEs, convertible notes, venture debt, and bootstrapping so you can choose the right instrument before you raise.
- [Venture Capital: How VC Works and What Founders Must Know](https://www.heyrupert.com/articles/venture-capital/): A complete guide to how venture capital works — fund structure, funding stages, what VCs look for, and how to run a disciplined fundraise as a founder.
